package.name: harambe_policy_legs_controller
package.description: ros2_control controller running an ONNX RL walking policy on the 12 leg joints. Builds a 52-dim observation (joint state + pelvis IMU + base velocity + cmd_vel + gait clock), runs inference at 50 Hz, and outputs POSITION targets with constant kp/kd ("mode 5"); the EtherCAT drive closes the PD loop at 1 kHz. No host-side torque / gravity compensation.
